name: catanova
description: An open-source island game for two to four friends, with balanced maps and recoverable multiplayer.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && vite build apps/client --outDir ../../dist/client --emptyOutDir && node dist/scripts/render-public-pages.js
scripts.dev: npm run build && tsx watch apps/server/src/index.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages tests scripts docs README.md
